summary.text: Bob Paulson is a Republican state senator from District 3 in Minot who took office in December 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A retired Navy pilot and rancher, he previously served in the North Dakota House of Representatives from 2018 to 2022.

paragraphs.text: Bob Paulson earned a bachelor's degree in business administration from Evangel University and served in the U.S. Navy.
His legislative biography describes him as a retired Navy pilot and rancher, and says he is married and has ten children.
Paulson represented District 3 in the North Dakota House of Representatives from 2018 to 2022 and assumed office in the Senate on December 1, 2022, succeeding Oley Larsen.
He faces Democrat Michael Thiesen in the general election.
His 2025 assignments include vice chair of the Judiciary Committee and membership on the Transportation Committee, and he chairs the interim Administrative Rules Committee.
